response.overview: Based on an Original Comic book created by Samuel Fadeley,  follows Dub and Bob on a high stake mission to reach a rooftop of  a building and as they fight through enemies which seem to get  tougher and stronger as they move up each floor. Soon this  mission they were called onto took an unexpected turn once they  managed to get to the roof. Did Dub and Bob meet their end or  was this the start to a better society with no war and suffering.  (Based on Battlefield 3-4 and Call of duty)
response.tagline: Ascend Every Floor-Until You Go Boom!
response.title: Boom!
